title: Rust authenticated frames omit required receipt clock evidence
description: rust/lichen-link AuthenticatedFrame seals payload/signer/counter/receiver/key generation but carries no immutable receive-monotonic timestamp or clock-domain identity, and receive_frame has no clock input. Modified spec/09-packets-timing requires authenticated DIO evidence to retain both values captured immediately after radio reception for freshness and time derivation. Add a no_std-capable exact clock-domain/timestamp evidence interface, bind it into owner-issued frames and DIO elevation, and add mutation/foreign-domain/regression/vector tests.
